producers3.title: Build 3 resource producers
producers3.hint: Place Lumberjacks, Quarries or Reindeer Herders on free hexes and let them finish building.

longhouse2.title: Upgrade your Longhouse to level 2
longhouse2.hint: Open the Longhouse and choose Upgrade.

storagehouse1.title: Build a Storage House
storagehouse1.hint: Place a Storage House on an empty grass hex.

producers6.title: Build 6 resource producers
producers6.hint: Keep adding Lumberjacks, Quarries and Reindeer Herders until six of them stand.

longhouse3.title: Upgrade your Longhouse to level 3
longhouse3.hint: Open the Longhouse and choose Upgrade again.

longhouse5.title: Upgrade your Longhouse to level 5
longhouse5.hint: Keep upgrading the Longhouse. Each level takes a little longer.

spearmen5.title: Train 5 spearmen
spearmen5.hint: Build a Barracks and train spearmen there. Any fighting land unit counts toward the five.

hunt1.title: Hunt a wildlife camp
hunt1.hint: Click a camp on your island, choose Hunt and send land troops. Weak camps (hares, deer, seals) are the easy first prey.
